response:
## 1) Severity: HIGH | Type: Bug
Title: Update stops merging the storage-updated object into the legacy write and uses the unwrapped objInfo

Affected:
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:134-141

Explanation:
The old code wrapped the object in `updateWrapper` so legacy received the same object that storage produced. The new code passes the original `objInfo` to `Legacy.Update`. Legacy therefore recomputes the update against its own old object. The two stores can diverge, for example when the update is driven by generation or resourceVersion. The goroutine also reuses `objInfo` and the request-scoped `ctx`. If that context is cancelled once the request returns, the legacy write is cancelled with it. Detach with `context.WithoutCancel` and pass `&updateWrapper{upstream: objInfo, updated: res}`.

Proposed fix:
~~~go
go func() {
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeoutCause(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 10*time.Second, errors.New("legacy update timeout"))
    defer cancel()
    _, _, err := d.Legacy.Update(ctx, name, &updateWrapper{upstream: objInfo, updated: res}, createValidation, updateValidation, forceAllowCreate, options)
    d.recordLegacyDuration(err != nil, mode3Str, options.Kind, method, startLegacy)
}()
~~~

## 2) Severity: HIGH | Type: Bug
Title: Legacy goroutines inherit the request context, so they are cancelled when the request ends

Affected:
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:50-57
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:108-114
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:161-167

Explanation:
The async legacy writes derive their context from the request `ctx`. That context is cancelled as soon as the handler returns, so legacy writes can be aborted intermittently and legacy storage silently falls out of sync. Use `context.WithoutCancel(ctx)` as the parent of the timeout context.

## 3) Severity: MEDIUM | Type: Bug
Title: Wrong metrics recorded for several failure and success paths

Affected:
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:45
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:106
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:129
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:166

Explanation:
- A storage failure in Create and Update is recorded with `recordLegacyDuration`.
- Delete success passes `name` instead of `options.Kind`, which produces a high-cardinality label.
- The DeleteCollection legacy goroutine calls `recordStorageDuration` instead of `recordLegacyDuration`.

Use the correct recorder and label in each case.

## 4) Severity: MEDIUM | Type: Bug
Title: Delete stores the unannotated logger in the context, and the Delete goroutine's legacy errors are never logged

Affected:
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:97
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:108-114

Explanation:
`klog.NewContext(ctx, d.Log)` drops the `log` variable that carries name, kind and method, so the call-specific fields are lost. Errors from the legacy goroutines in all write methods are only recorded as metrics and never logged. This makes legacy divergence hard to diagnose. Use `log` in the context and log the legacy errors.

## 5) Severity: MEDIUM | Type: Bug
Title: Possible nil pointer dereference on options

Affected:
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:38
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:65
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:81

Explanation:
`options.Kind` is dereferenced without a nil check in Create, Get, List and the other methods. Callers may pass nil options, which would panic. Get previously ignored `options` entirely and passed a fresh `GetOptions{}`. Guard against nil.

## 6) Severity: LOW | Type: Test
Title: Tests are weak and rely on a shared registry

Affected:
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3_test.go:63
- pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3_test.go:343

Explanation:
- The tests use a package-level `p` registry across many `NewDualWriter` calls, which can cause duplicate metric registration. Other tests create a fresh `prometheus.NewRegistry()`.
- The legacy goroutines are not awaited, so the legacy mock calls are never asserted.
- The create error case does not set up a storage mock; it sets up the legacy mock only.
